shots.scene: Medium close-up. YOU crouches behind a small round green bush on a city sidewalk: only his head and shoulders stick out above the top of the bush, the rest of him is hidden inside the bush. He looks nervous: eyes wide, eyebrows up, lips pressed together, glancing to the side. Blurry city street behind him with warm shop windows and street lamps. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Hook: green wavy stink lines rise from the bush. Slow push-in, small punch-in on "homeless".
shots.sound: City noise (traffic, far horns) from the first frame. Small bush rustle.

shots.scene: Wide shot of a busy city sidewalk in the early evening after rain. A small round green bush grows in a square of dirt between a lamp post and a fancy shop window. YOU crouches behind it: only his messy head and shoulders stick out above the top of the bush, small in the frame. People in coats walk past without looking at him. Tall buildings, glowing shop windows, wet shiny pavement with puddles.
shots.effect: The bush shakes. Green stink lines above it. Slow sideways pan.
shots.kling: The small bush shakes and wiggles, its leaves trembling. The guy's head looks left and right nervously. People walk past. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Close-up. YOU's head and shoulders above the top of the small bush. In front of his face he holds up the only two things he found: in one hand a single green leaf, in the other a crumpled old blank paper bus ticket. He stares at them with a blank, disappointed face. Blurry city street with warm lights behind.
shots.effect: Punch-in on "toilet paper". One sweat drop.

shots.scene: Low angle at street level, camera almost on the wet pavement. A long shiny black limousine slides in and stops at the curb right next to the small bush. Its black paint and chrome reflect the city lights, and the whole car is reflected upside down in a big rain puddle in the front of the image. The small bush with YOU's messy head poking out of the top is at the left edge.
shots.effect: Slow push-in. Small camera bump when the car stops.
shots.sound: Deep bass limo engine rumble, tyres on the wet road, brakes.
shots.kling: The long black limousine slides in slowly from the right and stops at the curb. Its reflection moves in the puddle, small ripples. Camera static, low angle. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of the black limousine's front wheel: a shiny gold wheel rim with small diamonds set into it, next to the glossy black car body with a thin gold stripe. The rim gleams. Wet pavement, city lights reflected in the black paint.
shots.effect: Slow pan along the car, sparkles on the gold rim. Punch-in on "black car".

shots.scene: Low-angle close-up of the limousine's back door swinging open: a gold door handle, the black door opening wide, warm golden light and a little soft mist pouring out from inside the car onto the wet sidewalk. Red velvet seats inside.
shots.effect: Golden light glow from the door. Slow push-in.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up at ground level, slow-motion look. A shiny red high-heel shoe steps out of the open limousine door onto the wet sidewalk and lands in a small puddle, little water drops splashing up. The edge of a white fur coat hangs above the shoe. Warm golden light from inside the car.
shots.effect: Slow-motion feel, slight push-in.
shots.sound: High-heel click on wet ground, water splash.
shots.kling: Slow motion: the red high heel slowly steps down from the car onto the wet sidewalk and touches the puddle, small water splashes. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Medium shot from a slightly low angle. The RICH LADY stands in front of the open black limousine, shown from the waist up: huge fluffy white fur coat, a giant sparkling diamond necklace, long straight dark hair, big black sunglasses, red lipstick, very calm deadpan face. City lights blurred behind her.
shots.effect: Tilt up from the fur coat to the necklace. On "Diamonds": punch-in on the necklace + sparkles.

shots.scene: Medium shot. The BODYGUARD jumps out of the front door of the black limousine in total panic: both hands up in the air, mouth wide open, eyebrows high above his sunglasses, sweat drops flying off his bald head. Wet city street behind him.
shots.effect: Shake. Sweat drops fly.

shots.scene: Close-up of the BODYGUARD leaning forward, whisper-shouting with a very worried face: eyebrows up, mouth open, one big hand reaching out, sweat on his forehead. Blurry limousine and city lights behind him.
shots.effect: Small shake, one sweat drop.

shots.scene: Close-up of the RICH LADY's face, very calm and deadpan: big black sunglasses, red lipstick, lips closed, chin up. She does not look at the bodyguard, she looks straight ahead. White fur collar, diamond necklace. Blurry city lights behind.
shots.effect: Hard cut, no camera move at all (deadpan).
shots.sound: City noise drops out for a moment.

shots.scene: Close-up of the BODYGUARD with his mouth snapped shut into a tight flat line, lips pressed together, cheeks puffed out a little, eyes wide behind his sunglasses, standing very stiff like a statue. Blurry city lights behind.
shots.effect: Tiny punch-in on the cut.

shots.voice: She walks straight to your bush.
shots.scene: Wide shot on the city sidewalk. The RICH LADY in her white fur coat walks calmly and straight toward the small round bush, which is in the front of the image with YOU's messy head poking out of the top (seen from behind). The black limousine waits at the curb behind her; the BODYGUARD stands next to it with both hands on his head. Wet shiny pavement, warm city lights.
shots.effect: Slow push-in toward her.
shots.sound: High-heel clicks, one per step. City noise quiet.

shots.scene: Close-up of YOU's face above the top of the bush, totally frozen: eyes wide open, mouth a tiny straight line, a single sweat drop on his forehead, leaves of the bush around his chin. Blurry city lights behind.
shots.effect: Freeze. One sweat drop rolls down.
shots.sound: All sound drops. One single heartbeat.

shots.scene: Close-up of the RICH LADY, frozen mid-step right in front of the bush, her face perfectly still, sunglasses on, one eyebrow slightly raised above the sunglasses. White fur collar, diamond necklace. Blurry city lights behind.
shots.effect: A little closer than the shot before. No movement.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of the RICH LADY slowly lowering her big black sunglasses with one finger: her small black dot eyes now show over the top of the sunglasses, looking down. Red lipstick. Soft warm light.
shots.effect: Even closer. Slow push-in.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of YOU's face looking up: kind small dot eyes, messy hair with a leaf stuck in it, scruffy beard. Soft warm light on his face.
shots.effect: The closest shot. Slow push-in.

shots.voice: Then she pulls out her silk handkerchief.
shots.scene: Close-up, slow-motion look. A shiny pink silk handkerchief with thin gold edges floats out of the rich lady's elegant hand (a big diamond ring on her finger), the silk flowing and rippling softly in the air. A heavenly beam of warm light falls on it, tiny sparkles around it. Blurry dark city lights behind.
shots.effect: Heavenly glow and sparkles. Slow push-in.
shots.kling: Slow motion: the pink silk handkerchief slowly flows and ripples out of her hand in the air, shining in a beam of warm light, tiny sparkles. Camera slowly pushes in. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.voice: It costs more than your whole life.
shots.scene: Medium shot of YOU's whole life: an old rusty shopping cart parked on the wet sidewalk next to the small bush, holding everything he owns: a rolled-up sleeping bag, a dented cooking pot, a blank piece of cardboard, a small potted plant, a yellow rubber duck and an umbrella with holes. Warm street-lamp light falls on it.
shots.effect: Slow sideways pan across the cart. Tiny zoom on "whole life".

shots.scene: Medium side view on the sidewalk. The RICH LADY holds the pink silk handkerchief out at arm's length, her arm perfectly straight, toward YOU, whose head and shoulders stick out above the top of the small bush. She looks straight ahead with a calm deadpan face; he stares at the handkerchief with big eyes. Warm city lights behind.
shots.effect: Slow push-in on the handkerchief.

shots.scene: Close-up of the RICH LADY's face, perfectly straight and deadpan, sunglasses back on, red lipstick, her hand holding the pink handkerchief out at the edge of the image. White fur collar, diamond necklace. Blurry city lights behind.
shots.effect: Hold still (deadpan). Tiny punch-in on "need this".

shots.scene: High wide shot looking down at the city street from above in the early evening: the long black limousine at the curb, the small round bush on the sidewalk, a lady in a white fur coat standing next to it, a big man in a black suit by the car. Wet streets shining with warm street lights, tiny people and cars.
shots.effect: Slow zoom in from above (documentary feel).
shots.sound: City noise far away, soft low "documentary" tone.

shots.voice: your brain decides if it likes someone's face
shots.scene: Close-up of a cute cartoon pink brain floating in the middle of the image, made of chunky low-poly shapes, with two small black dot eyes and a tiny smile, holding a big golden stopwatch in a tiny hand. Plain dark blue background with soft light, a few little sparkles.
shots.effect: The brain bobs a little. Punch-in on "someone's face".

shots.voice: in about a tenth of a second.
shots.scene: Extreme close-up of a big shiny golden stopwatch, its hand at the very beginning of the dial. The dial has simple tick marks and no numbers. Plain dark blue background with soft light.
shots.effect: I add a pixel "0.1 SEC" display over the stopwatch. Punch-in on "tenth".

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of the RICH LADY's face: her small black dot eyes go wide over the top of her lowered sunglasses, eyebrows up, cheeks a little pink, a tiny pink heart shining in each eye. Red lipstick.
shots.effect: Eyes go wide: quick punch-in. Pink sparkle.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of YOU's face: his small black dot eyes go wide, eyebrows up, cheeks pink, a leaf in his messy hair, scruffy beard.
shots.effect: Same punch-in. A big pink heart pops up in the middle at the end; small hearts start floating.

shots.scene: Wide shot of a super fancy restaurant: huge golden crystal chandeliers, gold walls, red velvet chairs, white tablecloths with candles, a pianist at a black grand piano in the back. In the middle, at a small candle-lit table, YOU (now clean, in a nice navy suit) sits across from the RICH LADY (white fur coat, diamond necklace, sunglasses pushed up on her head). They smile at each other.
shots.effect: Corner label "DAY 1". Slow push-in toward their table.
shots.sound: Restaurant piano music, soft clinking glasses.
shots.label: DAY 1

shots.voice: You eat steak with your hands.
shots.scene: Close-up of YOU (clean, nice navy suit, neat beard) at the fancy restaurant table, holding a huge juicy steak with both hands and biting into it, eyes closed, very happy. A fancy plate with a tiny garnish and untouched silver knife and fork in front of him. Candles and a golden chandelier blurred behind.
shots.effect: Punch-in on "hands".

shots.scene: Close-up of the RICH LADY at the fancy restaurant table, also holding a huge steak with both hands and taking a big bite, laughing with her eyes squeezed shut, sunglasses pushed up on her head, diamond rings on her fingers, diamond necklace. Candles and a golden chandelier blurred behind.
shots.effect: Small floating hearts.

shots.scene: Medium shot. The thin WAITER in a black tuxedo falls straight backwards, stiff as a board, eyes rolled up and mouth open, still holding up his silver tray while plates and wine glasses fly up off it. Golden chandeliers and red velvet chairs behind.
shots.effect: Shake when he hits the floor.
shots.sound: Plate crash, thud. Piano music stops.
shots.kling: The waiter slowly falls straight backwards, stiff as a plank, plates and glasses fly up off his tray. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Wide shot of the Eiffel Tower in Paris on a sunny golden afternoon, seen from a green park with a lawn, round trimmed bushes and a little path, a few fluffy clouds and birds.
shots.effect: Corner label "MONTH 3". Slow tilt up the tower.
shots.label: MONTH 3

shots.voice: You poop behind the Eiffel Tower.
shots.scene: Medium shot in a park in Paris, the Eiffel Tower big in the background. YOU (clean, nice navy suit, neat hair) crouches behind a small round trimmed bush: only his head and shoulders stick out above the top of the bush. He smiles calmly and happily, eyes half closed. Sunny golden light.
shots.effect: Green stink lines rise from the bush, mixed with small hearts.

shots.scene: Medium shot in the same Paris park, the Eiffel Tower behind. The RICH LADY (white fur coat, diamond necklace, sunglasses pushed up on her head) stands next to the small round bush, laughing, holding the pink silk handkerchief out toward YOU, whose head sticks out above the top of the bush. He smiles at her.
shots.effect: Floating hearts. Sparkle on the handkerchief.

shots.scene: Wide shot of an outdoor garden wedding on a sunny day: a white flower arch, rows of white chairs with guests, green lawn, flower petals in the air. Under the arch, YOU in a black tuxedo bows and kisses the back of the hand of the RICH LADY in a white wedding dress (with her big black sunglasses and her diamond necklace).
shots.effect: Corner label "YEAR 1". Flower petals, slow push-in.
shots.label: YEAR 1

shots.scene: Close-up of the BODYGUARD sitting in the front row at the outdoor wedding, crying his eyes out: big cartoon tears streaming down from under his sunglasses, mouth wide open in a loud wail, holding a huge white tissue to his nose. Wedding guests and flowers blurred behind.
shots.effect: Shake on every sob. Big cartoon tears.
shots.sound: Loud cartoon sobbing, a nose-blow honk.
shots.kling: The bodyguard sobs loudly, his shoulders shaking, big tears streaming down, he blows his nose into the huge tissue. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Wide shot of a cozy wooden house with a big front porch at sunset: a porch swing, warm light in the windows, a small garden in front with round bushes and flowers, a white picket fence, a golden pink sky.
shots.effect: Corner label "50 YEARS LATER". Slow push-in toward the porch.
shots.label: 50 YEARS LATER

shots.voice: Two old people on a porch.
shots.scene: Medium shot of OLD YOU and the OLD LADY sitting side by side on a wooden porch swing at sunset, both smiling softly. Warm golden light, flowers and round garden bushes around the porch.
shots.effect: Gentle sway like the swing.

shots.scene: Close-up of two old wrinkled hands holding each other on the porch swing: his hand with a beige cardigan sleeve, her hand with a big old diamond ring and a cream cardigan sleeve. Warm golden sunset light.
shots.effect: Small hearts float up.

shots.scene: Close-up of the OLD LADY on the porch swing, smiling softly and holding up the same pink silk handkerchief with gold edges, now faded and wrinkled with age. Warm sunset light.
shots.effect: Sparkle on the handkerchief.

shots.scene: Medium shot inside the cozy old house: on the flowery wallpaper hangs a fancy golden picture frame, and inside the frame is the old pink handkerchief, stiff, crusty and crumpled, pinned flat behind the glass like a museum piece. A small brass lamp lights it from above.
shots.effect: Small green stink lines rise from the frame. Slow push-in.
shots.sound: Piano pauses. A tiny fly buzz.

shots.scene: Wide shot of the cozy wooden house with the porch at sunset, seen from further away: the whole garden with round bushes in front, two tiny old people on the porch swing, and a big golden pink sky above the house with lots of empty space.
shots.effect: Ending like the plane: pink hearts and a few small green stink lines float up together into the sky. Slow zoom out.
